Problem Statement:
A financial application needs to calculate the sum of the digits of a given transaction ID to verify if the ID follows a particular pattern. The transaction ID is a numerical value, and by summing its digits, the system checks whether the sum meets certain criteria. If the sum is even, the transaction is valid; if odd, it requires further verification. 
Input Description:
The input is a numerical value representing a transaction ID. 
Output Description:
The output is the sum of the digits of the transaction ID. 
Sample Input:
9876 
Sample Output:
30
